description: Northern Provincial Council - Northern Province Pawn brokers Statute No. 06 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content contains the full text of the "Northern Province Pawnbrokers Statute No. 06 of 2017," which establishes a new legal framework for regulating pawnbroking businesses within the Northern Province. It includes provisions for registration, licensing, operational requirements, and regulatory compliance - all characteristic of legal/regulatory matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories, making it a clear example of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory).
